# eVera

> llms.txt for the eVera repository (embeddedos-org/eVera).
> Status: the autonomous agent of the EmbeddedOS ecosystem
> (private repo) — designed as an on-device system service
> driving the local MCP fabric, with a policy service, an
> event bus, and unit-test coverage tracked in issue #46.

eVera is the device agent of EmbeddedOS: it perceives, plans
and acts on the device itself under a policy envelope, rather
than as a cloud chatbot with device APIs.
